Additionally, the pink coloration is uniformly applied like a texture map, lacking natural subsurface scattering variations in the deep wrinkles, though this may be acceptable given the surreal prompt. The pose estimator flagged medium risk in limb keypoints (26% low confidence), suggesting some anatomical ambiguity in the legs/feet area, which aligns with the slight softness observed in the lower leg details. Despite these issues, the overall rendering quality remains strong.
